why: Notation only (reviewed 2026-10-26): the source is `∃ before after, … ∧ (∀ z ∈ after, y ≤ z) ∧ x < y`. The docs page, printed with TauCeti.Combinatorics.Young.RowInsertion's imports alone, writes out `∃ (before : List α), ∃ (after : List α)` and `∀ (z : α), z ∈ after → y ≤ z`; the dataset, printed with the whole library loaded, has Mathlib's delaborators, which merge the existentials and print the bounded quantifier. Same term, every binder's type shown or fixed by `after`.
